Swapnil S/O Nanaji Ingole And Others vs State Of Maharashtra,
Thr. Secretary, ... on 6 January, 2026
Author: Anil S. Kilor

Bench: Anil S. Kilor
2026:Bhc-Nag:109-Db
 1 Wp-4
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur
 Writ Petition No.4783 Of 2022
 [Swapnil S/o Nanaji Ingole and others Vs. State of Maharashtra, through its
 Department of Revenue, Mantralaya, Mumbai and others]
 Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram,
 appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's 
 and Registrar's orders.
 Shri P.B. Patil, Counsel for Petitioners.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Ms K.P. Marpakwar, Assistant Government Pleader for Respondent Nos.1, 2, 4 a
 Shri S.Y. Deopujari, Counsel for Respondent No.3.
 Coram : Anil S. Kilor And Raj D. Wakode, Jj.

The following prayers are made in the present petition :
"(a) direct the respondent No.2-District Collector, Amravati, the respondent
No.3-Chief Engineer, Madc and the respondent No.4-
Special L.A.O. to process the proposal for acquisition of the excess land of the petitioners
admeasuring 1.63 H.R. from Gat No.61/1 of Mouza Aadegaon (Khurd), Tahsil Nandgaon
Khandeshwar, District Amravati utilized for the construction road by Madc and initiate the process
of acquisition, forthwith and to pay the compensation to the petitioners in accordance withh
provisions of new land acquisition Act, 2013 (Act No.30 of 2013); forthwith;
(b) direct the respondent no.2-District Collector, Amravati to correct the revenue entries on the
basis of joint re-measurement report Dt.23.10.2020 & map Dt.28.07.2020 by Dy. Superintendent of
Land records, Nandgaon Khandeshwar at (Annexure-M2 & M3),
This petition is pending since last three years and even in this petition, there is no reply filed by the respondents till this date.

4. Considering the prayers made in the present petition and the fact that similar request is pending before the Collector, we are of the opinion that the purpose will be served if the direction is issued to the Collector to consider the representation of the petitioner at Page No.57 of this petition and also the subsequent representation along with the grounds raised as well as the prayers made in this petition, within the stipulated period.

5. Accordingly, we dispose of the present petition with a direction to the Collector, Amravati, the respondent No.2 herein, to decide the representations of the petitioners, and while doing so, take into consideration the grounds raised as well as the prayers made in the present petition.
Such decision shall be taken within a period of ten weeks from the date of production of this order before the Collector.
The 3 WP-4783-2022.odt decision taken shall be communicated to the petitioner within a period of two weeks from the date of such decision.
6. The petition is disposed of in the above-referred terms.

(RAJ D. WAKODE, J.) (ANIL S. KILOR, J.)
